empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Finite execution and enumeration validate the observed implementation and tested state spaces; they do not establish asymptotic results, large-state generator uniformity, geometric robustness, or production tails.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the two-layer RIC model, uniform-last lemma, backward charging, random search-tree derivation, conflict structures, history, geometric cavities, fixed-dimensional LP, degeneracy, and evidence boundaries.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives backward analysis from conditional symmetry, connects it to finite executable behavior and classical geometric algorithms, presents ten distinct theoretical and operational examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, computational-geometry, numerical-analysis, security, performance, or operational review is claimed. Results remain conditional on a fixed canonical input set, uniform permutation, proved update and charging correspondences, exact or consistently resolved predicates, and the recorded execution environment.
